people.featChoice.title: A Saga Feat
people.featChoice.body: The skalds begin to sing of {name}. Choose the deed they will remember: one feat of those offered.
people.captivity.title: In Chains
people.captivity.body: {name} is held by {captor}. The asking ransom is {ransom} silver. {weeks, plural, =0 {The first week passes slowly.} one {One week has passed.} other {# weeks have passed.}}
people.succession.title: The High Seat Stands Empty
people.succession.body: {deceasedName} is dead. {name} is heir, but too young to rule; a regent must hold the hall until the heir comes of age.
people.succession.skip: Let the regent rule until the heir comes of age
people.notify.levelUp: {name} has grown in skill and standing (level {level}).
people.notify.featChoice: {name} has reached level {level}. Choose a Saga Feat.
people.notify.featChosen: {name} has taken a new Saga Feat.
people.notify.titleChanged: Men now speak of {name} by a new name.
people.notify.deedName: After this deed, {name} is known by a new name.
people.notify.traitLost: {name} has put aside an old trait.
people.notify.death: {name} is dead{cause, select, oldAge { of old age} wounds { of wounds} battle { in battle} seaBattle { in a fight at sea} duel { in single combat} childbirth { in childbirth} illness { of a fever} captivity { in captivity} other {}} at {age}.
people.notify.houseFallen: {name} is dead, and no kin remain to take up the high seat. The house falls silent.
people.notify.succession: {deceasedName} is dead. {name} takes the high seat.
people.notify.regency: {name} is heir but still a child. {hasRegent, select, yes {{regentName} will rule as regent.} other {With no one fit to be regent, the child rules alone.}}
people.notify.regencyEnded: {name} has come of age and takes the high seat.
people.notify.regentReplaced: The regent is dead. {hasRegent, select, yes {{regentName} now rules for {name}.} other {{name} now rules alone.}}
people.notify.regencyRisk: {risk, select, treasury {The regent’s cautious rule has cost the treasury {amount} silver.} holdings {Without a grown ruler, the holdings grow restless.} other {The lieutenants chafe under the regent.}}
people.notify.regencyMode: {mode, select, skip {The regent will rule cautiously until {name} comes of age.} other {You take up the regent’s burden for {name}.}}
people.notify.wounded: {name} is {severity, select, minor {lightly wounded} serious {badly wounded} mortal {mortally wounded} other {wounded}}.
people.notify.injury: {name} suffers a lasting hurt: {injury, select, scar {a scar} brokenHand {a broken hand} crackedRibs {cracked ribs} concussion {a blow to the head} lostFingers {lost fingers} lameLeg {a lamed leg} lostEye {a lost eye} mortalWound {a mortal wound} other {an injury}}.
people.notify.survivedWound: Against the odds, {name} has lived through a mortal wound.
people.notify.combSaved: The healer-sisters of the Gray Queen’s Comb have saved {name} from death.
people.notify.injuryHealed: {name} has healed: {injury, select, brokenHand {the broken hand is whole} crackedRibs {the ribs have knit} concussion {the head is clear} other {the hurt is mended}}.
people.notify.healed: {method, select, seer {The seer} other {The church}} tends {name}’s wounds for {cost} silver.
people.notify.captured: {name} has been taken captive by {captor}. They ask {ransom} silver.
people.notify.released: {name} is free {reason, select, ransomed {— the ransom is paid} escaped {— escaped from captivity} rescued {— rescued by allies} fealty {— at the price of fealty} marriage {— by marriage} hostageReturned {— sent home now that the houses are at peace} other {again}}.
people.notify.ransomPaid: The steward pays {amount} silver to free {name}.
people.notify.escapeFailed: {name} tried to escape and was caught. The guard is doubled.
people.notify.bargainWon: {name} talks the captor down. The ransom is now {ransom} silver.
people.notify.bargainLost: The captor will not bargain with {name}. The ransom stays {ransom} silver.
people.notify.wordSent: {name} has smuggled word out to the house’s allies.
people.notify.captivityIllness: Cold, damp and poor food are wearing {name} down.
people.notify.birth: {twin, select, yes {Twins! } other {}}{parents, select, both {{name} is born to {motherName} and {fatherName}.} mother {{name} is born to {motherName}.} father {{name} is born to {fatherName}.} other {A foundling, {name}, is taken into the house.}}
people.notify.childRecovered: {name} was gravely ill, but the fever has broken.
people.notify.fostered: {name} goes {mode, select, tutor {to a tutor} lieutenant {to foster with a lieutenant} ally {to foster at an allied court} other {away}}.
people.chronicle.deedName: {name} won a new name by deed.
people.chronicle.death: {name} died{cause, select, oldAge { of old age} wounds { of wounds} battle { in battle} seaBattle { in a fight at sea} duel { in single combat} childbirth { in childbirth} illness { of a fever} captivity { in captivity} other {}} at {age}.
people.chronicle.houseFallen: With {name} died the last of the line. The house fell silent.
people.chronicle.regency: {deceasedName} died; {name}, still a child, became heir{hasRegent, select, yes {, and {regentName} held the hall as regent} other {}}.
people.chronicle.regencyEnded: {name} came of age and ruled in their own right.
people.chronicle.fealty: {name} bent the knee to {liege} to win freedom.
people.chronicle.birth: {twin, select, yes {Twins were born. } other {}}{parents, select, both {{name} was born to {motherName} and {fatherName}.} mother {{name} was born to {motherName}.} father {{name} was born to {fatherName}.} other {A foundling, {name}, was taken into the house.}}
people.narration.rulerDied: So ended the days of {name}. The hall was quiet that night.
people.narration.houseFallen: No son, no daughter, no kin to take the seat. With {name}, the house fell silent.
people.narration.childBorn: A child cried in the hall of {parentName}: {name} was born.
people.ui.noGame.title: No saga is being told
people.ui.noGame.body: Begin or load a saga to see your house.
people.ui.roleDesc.lieutenant: Leads a squad on expeditions and in battle, and can foster the house’s children.
people.ui.roleDesc.governor: Rules one of your holdings in your name: its taxes, building and order rest on this person’s Stewardship.
people.ui.roleDesc.envoy: Speaks for the house at foreign courts.
people.ui.roleDesc.captain: Commands one of your fleets at sea.
people.ui.roleDesc.steward: Keeps the house’s affairs while you are away. There is only one steward: naming a new one makes the old one a lieutenant.
people.ui.roleDesc.seer: The household seer: tends the wounded (with Runecraft) and sick children.
people.ui.foster.desc.tutor: A tutor teaches one chosen skill at home: one point every three years.
people.ui.foster.desc.lieutenant: The child learns the lieutenant’s best skill, and the lieutenant’s loyalty rises.
people.ui.foster.desc.ally: The child lives at the allied court: their opinion of you rises and the child gains Speechcraft. If relations sour, the child becomes a hostage.
people.ui.error.failed: Something went wrong; that cannot be done now.
people.ui.error.noHoldings: You hold no holding to govern.
people.ui.error.noFleets: Your house has no fleet to command.
people.ui.error.noMentor: None of your lieutenants can foster a child now.
people.ui.error.noCourtFound: No court is friendly enough to foster your child.
people.ui.error.notYours: That person does not serve your house.
people.ui.error.isRuler: The ruler holds no lesser office.
people.ui.error.isRegent: The regent serves until the heir comes of age.
people.ui.error.noHealer: No seer of your house is at the patient’s side. Appoint one in the Longhouse.
people.ui.error.healerAway: The healer is not with the patient.
people.ui.error.healerTooUnskilled: Your seer lacks the Runecraft to save a wound this grave.
people.ui.error.alreadyTreated: This wound has already been tended.
people.ui.error.cannotTreatMortal: Only a skilled seer can save a mortal wound.
people.ui.error.cannotAfford: You do not have enough silver.
people.ui.error.notFostered: This child is not being fostered.
people.ui.error.wrongAge: Children are fostered from 6 to 15 years of age.
people.ui.error.focusRequired: Choose a skill for the tutor.
people.ui.error.notLieutenant: That person cannot foster a child now.
people.ui.error.notAllied: Only an allied court will foster your child.
people.ui.error.noRuler: Your house has no living ruler.
people.ui.error.notRecognized: The Allthing will not recognise an adoption by one so dishonoured.
people.ui.error.inRegency: The succession is settled by the regency.
people.ui.sheet.lede: Who this person is: body, skills, nature, deeds and kin.
people.ui.sheet.missing: This person is not known to the saga.
people.ui.sheet.loyaltyDesc: How faithfully this person serves you. Disloyal followers shirk, quarrel and may leave.
people.ui.sheet.mortal: Mortally wounded. Life or death will be decided by {date}
people.ui.sheet.pregnant: With child; the birth is due about {date}
people.ui.sheet.unspent: {points, plural, one {# point to spend} other {# points to spend}}
people.ui.sheet.noTraits: No marked traits yet. Deeds, injuries and upbringing will shape them.
people.ui.sheet.maxLevel: The highest level a saga can sing.
people.ui.sheet.xpToNext: {xp} of {next} experience for the next level
people.ui.sheet.xpHow: Experience comes from victories, duels, raids, trade, voyages of discovery, relics and diplomacy. Each level brings a skill point.
people.ui.sheet.nextFeat: A Saga Feat is offered at level {level}.
people.ui.sheet.personalDesc: Standing this person would carry into a succession.
people.ui.sheet.favorDesc: The average Favor of the gods. Favor feeds the omens and some gods give more.

people.ui.family.lede: Your spouse, children and heir, the wards you may adopt, and the dead of your house.
people.ui.family.noRuler: Your house has no living ruler.
people.ui.family.heirDesc: Who takes the high seat when you die. A child, sibling, niece, nephew or adopted child may be named; otherwise the eldest of them inherits.
people.ui.family.noHeir: No one could inherit today. If you die, the nearest adult kin takes the seat; with none, the house falls silent.
people.ui.family.regency: {heir} is heir but still a child. {hasRegent, select, yes {{regent} rules as regent.} other {No regent rules for the child.}}
people.ui.family.noSpouse: You are unmarried. Marriages are arranged through audiences, envoys and the fortunes of war.
people.ui.family.fosterLater: Can be tutored or fostered from age {age}.
people.ui.family.adoptionDesc: A ward fostered at your court or a kinsman’s child may be adopted as your own and so become an heir. The Allthing refuses if your Honor is below {honor}.
people.ui.family.noAdoptable: No ward or kin’s child can be adopted now.
people.ui.family.noDead: None of your house has died yet.
